topics.name: DWH Query Optimizer Plan Boundary
topics.purpose: Define optimizer plans as derived execution strategies that may choose indexes, join order, pushdown and algorithms only when semantically and governance equivalent to the canonical query.

semantics.input_rule: Optimizer consumes exact canonical query definition, resolved schemas/relations, capabilities and statistics evidence.
semantics.plan_rule: Generated plan has a distinct execution-plan identity.
semantics.semantic_rule: Every plan transformation must preserve canonical query semantics.
semantics.join_rule: Join reordering is permitted only where declared relation/operator semantics are equivalent.
semantics.pushdown_rule: Remote pushdown follows the explicit federation pushdown boundary.
semantics.index_rule: Index use is optional execution strategy and never changes result meaning.
semantics.governance_rule: Optimizer cannot introduce reads of unauthorized fields/resources merely for cost/performance.
semantics.fallback_rule: If optimized plan cannot be proven compatible, execution falls back to a valid explicit plan or fails.
semantics.authority_rule: Optimizer cost preference is not authorization.

invariants.rule: Indexes, statistics, caches and optimizer plans may change execution strategy only; they never change canonical query semantics, data identity, ownership, classification or authorization.

hard_gates.condition: optimizer reads unauthorized field for selectivity
join reordered where semantics are not equivalent

references.purpose: Plans derive from canonical query semantics.
